Court Case Over PM Modi's Degree Sees Challenge from CJP Founder

Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP), has challenged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to publicly disclose his university degree. This challenge was made in the context of a Delhi High Court proceeding concerning the Prime Minister's educational qualifications. Dipke himself has faced scrutiny regarding his own academic credentials from Boston University. The court's involvement centers on the secrecy surrounding Modi's degree. The specific details of the court's decision or further proceedings were not detailed in the coverage.
